name: CED - South Burlington
old_description: Our local strength scales to the national level – an account at CED Burlington plugs you into our network throughout the country, gaining you access to the hard-to-find items you need to get you off the job site.
about:
CED Burlington operates from Williston, Vermont, as part of a national electrical distribution network that traces its roots to 1957 when the first Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED) location opened in California. The company has since grown to nearly 800 branches across the United States, each empowered to make local stocking and service decisions while leveraging the broader organization’s purchasing power.

The Williston branch stocks and supplies a wide range of electrical equipment including gear packages, service entrance materials, load centers, disconnects, meter mains, and circuit breakers with GFCI, AFCI, and dual-function variants. Beyond product distribution, the location provides value-added services: a licensed lighting designer develops multi-layer residential lighting plans; estimators perform takeoffs from electrical drawings; project managers offer custom reporting with shipping dates and delivery tracking; and the facility provides customer storage with staged delivery to job sites. Emergency same-day delivery and after-hours weekend availability are also offered.

The branch primarily serves residential and commercial electrical contractors, positioning itself as the “Residential Contractors’ Supplier of Choice.” Its gear package capabilities also support larger commercial and industrial projects requiring service entrance equipment and switchgear. Contractors rely on the branch for both standard stock items and hard-to-find components sourced through the national CED network.

CED’s founding motto—“Service. Integrity. Reliability.”—drives its operational philosophy. Local managers have authority to tailor inventory and services to their market, while the national footprint enables next-day UPS Red Label shipping on many items and access to products from virtually any major electrical manufacturer. The combination of local autonomy, a licensed lighting designer on staff, and a commitment to emergency delivery distinguishes the Williston location in the Vermont market.
